heading.title: Of Transfers of Property by Act of Parties1

article.title: Transfer to members of a class who attain a particular age.
article.content:
22Transfer to members of a class who attain a particular age.

Section 22  ·  Chapter II  ·  (A) Transfer of Property, whether moveable or immoveable  ·  page 13 of the Act
Where, on a transfer of property, an interest therein is created in favour of such members only of a class as shall attain a particular age, such interest does not vest in any member of the class who has not attained that age.
